svg.title: Novi Kvadrat Design System: One design system for a property platform, from the mark to the tokens, in light and dark.
svg.desc: Designer and developer of the system. 187 colour roles. 21 type steps. W3C DTCG tokens. Figma · design tokens · CSS · Tailwind. Case study: https://secretocho.design/work/novi-kvadrat-design-system/
